scope: Independent read-only method/source review. No controller edits, parameter search or extra SUMO runs for this review. The separately authorized cooperative ablation has its own package, manifests and runs.

verified_source.relative_to_E11: All rule AST nodes identical; H is a formatting-only freeze of E11.
relative_to_original_D_rule_AST: _decide receives own actuation feedback and calls insertion distance
verified_source.review_verdict: No privileged information path or newly weakened common safety guard found. H has functional formation/transform evidence, but traffic and formation-specific causal claims remain conditional on the full H100 and cooperative ablation.

local_information_boundary.sensor_adapter: native_sumo.LocalTracks.observe selects physical states only in ego[-100,+200]m. True SUMO IDs remain inside the adapter/recorder; rules receive separately numbered private tracks, physical x/y/v/lane/vy/acceleration/time and ego track0.
local_information_boundary.head_matching_proof: For ego at0, a candidate peer is within[-50,+50]. The reverse-nearest search needs candidates within peer±50, hence[-100,+100]. Determining whether any such candidate is a head needs only its forward50m, hence the union[-100,+150]. This is contained in the actual[-100,+200] input. Occupancy predicates do not expand the longitudinal bound.
local_information_boundary.head_matching_assumptions: The proof assumes all physical rows in that declared window are supplied, as the current adapter does; it is not an occluded/noisy perception proof. The 50m head test and reverse search use exactly the same local physical rows.
local_information_boundary.identity_and_priority: Private track values are used for identity equality, current-gap identity memory and action references. Head nearest ordering uses projected geometric difference, x,y,speed,vy; no true ID, global rank or absolute private-track priority appears. The rules module imports only dataclasses and math.
local_information_boundary.own_pending: Only ego gets active_lane_request from its own previously submitted lane attempt and measured completion. Neighbor Vehicle.pending_lane stays at its default None. No rule reads another car's pending_lane or intended lane. The 1.2s execution bookkeeping is existing own-actuation handling, not a new traffic-release gate.
local_information_boundary.other_local_rules: The head connection radius is50m; this must not be described as the total perception radius. _make_room and _fill retain bounded90m/local-component geometry, and safety retains200m. _fill's temporary cells are recomputed from visible actual positions; no shared global slot table or persistent global rank is added.
local_information_boundary.limits: Independent local helper/fill choices are not proven globally identical under truncated views. This is an empirical coordination/stability limit, not a hidden information channel.

geometry_and_dynamics.following: A real same-corridor front within50m gets target front.x−30 and reference front.speed. Followers receive no additional body phase. Without such a front, ego is a local head; only mutual nearest real adjacent-lane heads within50m contribute phase.
geometry_and_dynamics.phase: Both sides use q=x+_physical_phase(car,lanes). For fixed lane count, the projection is continuous in measured lateral y and equals the old discrete phase at lane centers. Physical/geometric tie-breaking avoids an ID order.
geometry_and_dynamics.what_is_bounded: The phase contribution to desired reference speed is clipped to±2m/s; the returned head request also contains the existing .2 relaxation of current speed. The whole controller is not capped at28.8, and a newly promoted head can retain higher speed while relaxing. All physical speeds remain subject to33.3 and common safety.
geometry_and_dynamics.what_is_not_proved: The complete controller is not globally continuous: front50m membership, nearest-head identity, lane adjacency and the intended3→2 phase-frame change can switch. The physical projection alone must not be described as a global no-jump theorem.
geometry_and_dynamics.reciprocity_limit: Within a shared lane-count frame and common head branch, a mutual pair has opposite raw projected error. During preparation, retained lanes use the two-lane frame while ending-lane cars can still use three; another car may also be executing a different branch. Saturation, guard clipping, open boundaries and these branch/frame differences prevent a whole-fleet zero-sum or cruise-neutrality theorem. Actual straight-road evidence is still required.
geometry_and_dynamics.functional_evidence: Frozen E11/H-equivalent rule: scrambled six straight first full six at11.3s, confirmed100–1000m participation .608369/peak6; original already-formed six drop first full six downstream33.8s, downstream participation .599520/peak6. The original fixture proves transformation/recovery, not initial formation. These are small functional probes, not continuous-flow efficacy.

insertion_distance_and_shared_safety.formula: d_insert=max(8,4+1.5+.2*v_rear+max(v_rear²−v_incoming²,0)/(2*10)). Final formation spacing remains GAP30; the insertion allowance is not a new global formation spacing.
insertion_distance_and_shared_safety.derivation: The common stopping guard solves v_rear²+2*B*tau*v_rear <= v_front²+2*B*(gap−L−g0). Its gap requirement is L+g0+tau*v_rear+(v_rear²−v_front²)/(2B). H clips the speed-square contribution below at0, making the faster-incoming case conservative, and also retains the8m corridor floor.
insertion_distance_and_shared_safety.implementation_boundary: The open_gap branch uses min(existing following speed,_request(target,incoming.speed)), so that branch itself cannot request an increase above its preexisting base request. This does not forbid base following or join/merge paths from accelerating.
insertion_distance_and_shared_safety.common_guards: safe_speed, _clear, physical vType parameters and the engine's common min(command,safety_cap,33.3) plus common lane guard are unchanged from the strict-pending baseline. All policies still use length4,width1.8,minGap1.5,tau.2,accel5,decel10,emergencyDecel30,maxSpeed33.3 and native SUMO checks.
insertion_distance_and_shared_safety.safety_claim_limit: These formulas and common guards do not prove safety for every arbitrary maneuver/state. The complete100-case safety/completion/source audit remains necessary.

NOA_and_source_fairness.within_H100: H NOA uses the same frozen engine, vehicle model, guard, request tape and own-pending lifecycle as H formation/transform. It skips _following/_fill and transform helper/receiving; normal passing and necessary merge remain ordinary baseline decisions.
NOA_and_source_fairness.relative_to_old_D: The own-pending execution repair changed shared execution handling after original D, including its NOA execution path. Do not describe H-versus-original-D as a pure two-rule intervention or silently mix the old D NOA with H runs. Final traffic comparisons need same-H-source NOA; the historical D diagnosis remains separately labeled.
NOA_and_source_fairness.global_reference: The global planner is instantiated only for modeglobal and is not consulted by H NOA/formation/transform. A bundled global_reference.py snapshot is not evidence of Cai performance, optimality, or a centralized benchmark result.

three_mechanism_research_narrative.recommended_structure: Three mechanisms can organize the scientific narrative, but cannot honestly explain every E1–E11 failure as an isolated proven cause. Keep a short candidate ledger/source hashes separately and keep the E3 actuation-lifecycle defect as an engineering correction.

mechanisms.name: Over-distant front chaining and cruise-speed confounding
mechanisms.direct_evidence: E8 removed the component/count bypass but followed visible same-lane fronts over long gaps. Its q1500 straight TT37.545288s,100–1000m mean32.502009m/s and overspeed exposure fraction .964887 were measured, while upstream participation was0. E10's50m forming radius brought the q1500 straight mean to29.024214m/s; E11/head-only brought it to28.773901m/s. Old D100 net bottleneck attribution was negative at all four flows.
mechanisms.scope_limit: These source versions differ in more than one scientific mechanism along the full sequence. Do not turn this into a claimed single-factor quantitative mediation percentage; H can still accelerate inside real local groups.

mechanisms.name: Body/head phase mismatching leaves dangling ends
mechanisms.direct_evidence: E10 original-six trajectory at34.7s had actual3:3 lane counts but projected q approximately lane0[1109.166,1081.306,1051.735], lane1[1082.629,1052.035,1022.011]. Only the middle two rows formed a closed four-car group. In the saved real-frame RED/GREEN, E11 makes the true heads C1/A1 correct opposite phase, while internal B1/A2 use only real fronts. The original-six full-six recovery then passed.
mechanisms.scope_limit: This directly supports the topology correction for the recorded counterexample and functional probes; it does not by itself establish continuous-flow traffic benefits.

mechanisms.name: Demanding the full30m formation gap before insertion causes unnecessary yielding
mechanisms.direct_evidence: In the canonical six snapshot, two rear receivers already have15m longitudinal clearance at equal28.8m/s. D's target incoming.x−30 requests27.9m/s; the safe insertion target incoming.x−11.26 leaves their base request28.8. Old D segment evidence separately localized an extra .795175s cost in640–800m and a .358439s gain in800–1100m.
mechanisms.scope_limit: The static rule counterexample proves an unnecessary speed request in that state. The whole .795175s preparation cost cannot be attributed exclusively to this branch without a matched isolated ablation. H retains helper selection even when a head can already clear, because the original complete six needs that relocation for2:2:2→3:3.

three_mechanism_research_narrative.failures_not_to_hide: E1/E2/E3/E4/E5/E6/E7 also exposed formation weakness, slow-feedback effects, a genuine own-pending execution race, and incomplete/negative performance. In particular E7 q1500 transform59.182841s versus same-pilot NOA42.791421s with zero upstream/downstream participation remains a rejection. Do not retrofit every such failure to one of the three mechanisms or omit it because it complicates the story.

required_H100_claim_checks: Verify all100 attempts, each case's six source snapshots, common physical/tape hashes, complete .1s coverage and no source/seed mixing. Keep unsafe/incomplete/censored cases explicit.

Report each flow separately with five paired seeds. Full-trip benefit alone is insufficient; inspect fixed640–1100m drop-minus-straight change versus same-source NOA and existing low-speed/density/speed/flow metrics.
At500/750, report no meaningful congestion when that is what the fixed measurements show. Do not demand every flow improve or change thresholds to obtain a positive claim.
Check straight-road speed/TT and local overspeed as confounding diagnostics. H does not have a hard cruise cap, so the formula alone cannot establish no free-flow benefit.

Report actual three-lane upstream and two-lane downstream full multilayer participation, hold and size, not controller labels or lane-change counts. Low upstream participation weakens a claim that the observed traffic effect required an already formed platoon.

A positive H-versus-NOA DID can establish a benefit of this combined decentralized policy under the experiment; it does not identify formation as the cause. Compare the explicitly source-bound cooperative-only ablation.

If cooperative-only gives the same benefit, attribute it to local cooperative merging/gap provision; do not describe it as a demonstrated platoon benefit. If H adds benefit, describe the measured incremental formation-plus-fill strategy contrast, with actual participation and all residual costs.
Do not evaluate only a selected formed subgroup and call its better outcome causal; membership is affected by the policy and traffic state.

cooperative_ablation_boundary_review.material_issue_found_and_resolved_in_spe: Simply disabling _following/_fill with mode transform does not make straight identical to NOA: the normal_overtake branch is NOA-only and organized ongoing execution uses _join_speed. The authorized C0 implementation therefore delegates the entire straight _decide to NOA, while preserving metadata modecooperative.
cooperative_ablation_boundary_review.authorized_implementation: Separate H_cooperative_ablation only. organized stays true; forming is false for cooperative. Formation following and _fill are gated off; transform helper/receiving/preparation and actual merge/join/pending remain. Normal overtaking permits cooperative as requested. No new main mode is added.
cooperative_ablation_boundary_review.source_audit: Only rules._decide and native_sumo.MODES differ in the core AST from H. Existing helper, receiving distance, merge, _join_speed, own pending handler, common guard and physics are unchanged functions. A frozen source_diff.patch and per-case snapshots bind the policy; no runtime replacement is used.
cooperative_ablation_boundary_review.static_tests: Nine RED/GREEN checks. Matching helper, two receiving, necessary-merge and pending-execution states produce exactly the H command/memory; real profiling confirms cooperative calls neither _following nor _fill; straight ordinary overtaking and ongoing pending action exactly match NOA.
cooperative_ablation_boundary_review.actual_straight_checks: At500 and1500 seed1, actual10s cooperative and frozen-H NOA runs have byte-identical native.rou.xml, complete trips.json and decompressed positions.jsonl.gz. H_cooperative_ablation/straight_equivalence_report.json records paths and both digests. The complete straight delegation, not the two short probes alone, justifies defining the no-bottleneck policy as ordinary NOA.
cooperative_ablation_boundary_review.interpretation_limits: Identical helper formulas do not imply the same realized helper selections along H and C0 trajectories, since forming changes the state. C0 may accidentally exhibit geometric full layers and must still use the same detector. The allowed ordinary-overtake branch is an explicit strategy difference, so H−C0 isolates the formation/fill policy package rather than a pure scalar formation force.

State the own-pending lifecycle repair separately from the three scientific mechanisms and do not silently reuse historical source versions as H controls.
